description_en: Queries a paginated list of scenario overviews
description_zh: 分页查询场景概览信息
name: ListPtsScene

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value can be from 1 to 1,073,741,824
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of scenarios to display on each page. The value can be from 10 to 1,000
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示场景条数，取值范围10~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The keyword. Use it to perform a fuzzy search by **SceneName** or an exact search by **SceneId**
parameters.help_zh: 关键字，可以通过对场景名**SceneName**进行模糊搜索或者对场景ID**SceneId**进行精确搜索
parameters.name: key_word
